comparison.objective: Set and lock a gripper opening stop versus install an oversized cabinet shelf through a narrower face-frame opening.
comparison.physical_skill: Candidate uses small-tool seating and coupled rotational force control; shelf installation requires bimanual roll-to-fit transport, in-cavity leveling, and four-point support placement.
comparison.success_condition: Candidate requires a locked angle that survives cycling; shelf success requires released contact on all four pins, level and square placement, and a specified back gap.
comparison.reason: The shelf task tests constrained large-object reorientation and support placement, not threaded adjustment retention.
